text:
```yaml
name: OpenTherm v4.2 Spec Audit

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  spec-audit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python 3.x
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt || true

      - name: Run OpenTherm v4.2 Spec Audit
        run: |
          chmod +x scripts/spec_audit.sh
          ./scripts/spec_audit.sh

      - name: Verify ADR backlog closure
        run: |
          # Check that ADR-044 and ADR-045 exist in the docs/adr directory
          if ! find docs/adr -type f -name '*ADR-044*' > /dev/null; then
            echo "ADR-044 not found in docs/adr"
            exit 1
          fi
          if ! find docs/adr -type f -name '*ADR-045*' > /dev/null; then
            echo "ADR-045 not found in docs/adr"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "ADR-044 and ADR-045 are present"

      - name: Notify Slack on failure
        if: failure()
        uses: slackapi/slack-github-action@v2.1.1
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.SLACK_BOT_TOKEN }}
          channel: '#ci'
          text: 'OpenTherm v4.2 Spec Audit failed on ${{ github.repository }}'

      - name: Notify Slack on success
        if: success()
        uses: slackapi/slack-github-action@v2.1.1
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.SLACK_BOT_TOKEN }}
          channel: '#ci'
          text: 'OpenTherm v4.2 Spec Audit succeeded on ${{ github.repository }}'
```
